title: Commons Math fraction percentages across integer overflow
summary: Multiplying a numerator by 100 in its integer representation changes the percentage near the signed 32-bit boundary.

change.description: Multiplying a numerator by 100 in its integer representation changes the percentage near the signed 32-bit boundary.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 13 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 4 for bits, 0 for normal. fix mismatches were 0 for bits, 0 for normal.

The numerical checker was re-run on all six original obligations. Each still stops at the Fraction class initializer before the percentage result can be checked. The independent thirteen-value JVM grids and their four parent bit discrepancies remain the evidence for these claims.
